# v2026.11.15

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.11.15.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.11.15.md).

This release covers **5 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- Every job card and the Jobs list show the job's invoice status, with the words the Invoices page uses. A paid invoice no longer reads Pending. ([#537](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/537))
- An owner or admin can send one Pending invoice to Xero as a draft when its GST differs from its Xero item. An Override dialog asks for each warning to be ticked and a reason, and Flow keeps a record of who sent it. ([#535](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/535))
- A sent invoice that already has the work system's shipping line is no longer flagged as "Job changed". Recheck clears the old flags. ([#538](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/538))
- Price codes show the lines that wait for a code and link the work system's product to a price item. ([#534](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/534))

## Changes

- Override: only the "GST differs from Xero item" warning can be overridden. The invoice always goes to Xero as a draft, and the sent invoice shows a notice. A new table keeps each override; existing tables do not change. ([#535](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/535))
- Every job shows its invoice status on the Jobs board and in the Jobs list. ([#537](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/537))
- Price codes: a work system invoice line takes the product code from its order line, the page lists the waiting lines and links the product, a saved choice can be below zero, and rows and errors have Copy prompt. After the update, the first pipeline run reads every job again once, from Flow's own copy. A job with an invoice goes to review when one of its lines gets a code or loses one. ([#534](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/534))

## Fixes

- A sent invoice that already carries the work system's line is not a job change. ([#538](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/538))
